acceptanceCriteria.criterion: CapabilityRegistry Class: Central registry of all Jarvis capabilities
Capability Model: Name, type, description, status, dependencies
Auto-Discovery: Scan codebase for registered capabilities
API Endpoint: GET /api/admin/capabilities returns full registry
GapDetector Agent: Identifies missing or weak capabilities
Gap Model: What's missing, why it matters, suggested resolution
Heuristic Rules: Pattern matching for common gaps
API Endpoint: GET /api/admin/gaps returns detected gaps
Capability Dashboard: UI view of all capabilities and gaps
Gap Prioritization: Rank gaps by impact and effort
Trend Tracking: Track gap resolution over time
